messages:
Mina: quick idea 9preflight run9 in the rollout composer 1: run a sim over the last N minutes and show "what would have fallen back". anyone had thoughts on UX?
Sanjay: love it. we should show a concise table: trigger matched, pct of traffic affected, estimated cost delta, quota warn. small and scannable.
Wei: UX nit: show a compatibility flag per fallback target (api-compatible, token-length-ok, requires-conversion). block the toggle if incompatible.
Priya: also need to indicate where fallback will land: hosted/shared vs dedicated/reserved capacity. composer should surface headroom warnings and a CTA to request capacity if needed.
Mina: agreed. for headroom we can surface a soft-block: warn + require ack if fallback uses reserved capacity beyond available headroom.
Sanjay: telem/ audit: each preflight should produce a snapshot id that we store with the policy. snapshot links to sample inputs (redacted), metric windows, and the hypothetical routing map.
Wei: redaction default yes. plus a small "show raw" toggle with 2FA for sensitive routes.
Priya: can we show an inline diff of responses for model swap? tiny sample of 3 requests side-by-side: original vs fallback. label if truncation possible.
Mina: sounds good. minimal sample to avoid PII leakage. backend will redact and hash user ids.
Sanjay: policy schema for storage (compact form for preview):
```
{"id":"afb-26-03-21-02","triggers":[{"metric":"errors_5xx","op":">=","val":50,"window_s":60}],"mode":"hard-switch","fallback":"m-small-quant","safety":{"sample_pct":0.0,"ttl_s":1800}}
```
Wei: nice. ensure every activation writes: event_id, policy_id, preflight_snapshot_id, activating_user (or system), and trace_id. deploy-bot should post the audit link.
deploy-bot: preflight snapshot created snapshot://afb-26-03-21-02-001 by Mina.
Priya: question about sample_pct=0.0 for hard-switch: if operator wants canary, composer should flip to soft-sample and propose rates based on traffic volume. default soft sample = min(5% of QPS, 50rps).
Mina: good heuristic. also include an "impact estimator": rough latency change, token-cost delta, and expected error reduction if known. show ranges not exact.
Sanjay: on triggers composition: we need AND/OR and an option to invert (NOT). keep UI as pill chips with visual boolean builder. summary text like "when p95>600ms AND errors>2%".
Wei: we should expose the raw DSL for power users and a human summary for the rest. store normalized AST in backend for evaluation.
Priya: audit timeline: preflight->activated->first_trigger->metrics_snapshot->deactivated. CSV export with timestamps and counts.
Mina: ops flow: if fallback uses a different API contract, composer should surface a compatibility check and a one-click adapter suggestion (truncate/reshape) with a warning.
Sanjay: also add a small "rollback on regression" checkbox: if quality eval webhook reports a negative delta within X minutes, auto-roll back. must be opt-in and auditable.
Wei: security note: any auto-rollback or auto-fallback that touches PII routes requires enterprise approval. composer should hide that option for those routes.
Priya: final tiny UX: the composer footer should show three small badges: Preflight snapshot, Quota check, Audit link (if already enabled). each badge opens modal.
Mina: perfect. I'll create a quick mock and attach to the design thread. can @Sanjay and @Wei review before EOD?
Sanjay: will review at 4pm PT.
Wei: I'll check compatibility checks and the AST storage pattern.
Mina: thanks all 1 9 I'll post the mock + the JSON payload examples in the design thread shortly.
